name: nurok-kb-capture
description: Inspect, capture, and refresh immutable canonical original evidence for Nurok knowledge bases.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect or capture original KB evidence
interface.longDescription: Inspect existing capture state, or capture and refresh explicitly approved canonical original source evidence without transforming content or publishing KB revisions.
defaultPrompt: Inspect existing capture state without fetching source content or writing state.
